summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat printed a round-by-round account of Tom Allen's fight with Jem Mace near New Orleans, which ended in the tenth round when Mace threw Allen heavily and Joe Coburn threw up the sponge.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads Daily Democrat, Friday Morning, May 13, 1870. Current summary wrongly says the fight was May 13 at Cincinnati; it was May 10 near New Orleans.

facts.fact: Allen lost to Jem Mace in ten rounds; Mace threw him heavily on his head and shoulders and Allen's second Joe Coburn threw up the sponge
Coburn said Allen's shoulder was dislocated by the fall; a surgeon found it was not dislocated but the muscles were cramped and contracted
During the tenth round Allen said to Mace, "Hard work, Jem," and Mace replied, "'Deed it is, Master Tom."
